newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen doing overnight RPS, add need said small.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen doing overnight RPS, add need said small.

text.p: The Federal Reserve will probably inject reserves into the banking system via overnight system repurchase agreements on Wednesday, market sources said.

But the Fed's add need on the last day of the maintenance period is light -- probably only $1 billion to $2 billion. It is conceivable they could skip open market operations entirely on Wednesday, sources added.
The Fed could begin the new two-week maintenance period on Thursday with five-day fixed system RPs, which would cover the Memorial Day holiday weekend, they said.

With the need for reserves growing in coming weeks, analysts still said a permanent injection of reserves could come as early as Wednesday, via an outright purchase of bills or, less likely, a coupon pass.
However, the timing is hard to predict and analysts said a pass may not come until early June.
The federal funds rate was trading at 5-9/16 percent, above its 5-1/2 percent target early Wednesday.
